risks.title: Claude attempts to integrate everything at once
risks.trigger: More than one adoption lane or more than one authority jump is proposed in a single phase.
mitigation: Select one explicit goal and one phase.
Use separate commits and acceptance gates.
rollback: Revert the phase and return to phase_00_orientation.

risks.title: Quality gate is altered to make more videos pass
risks.trigger: Changes touch score weights, auto-fails, threshold, verdict logic, or publish fail direction.
mitigation: Compare immutable symbol hashes before and after.
rollback: Revert immediately and retain the blocked artifact.

risks.title: Preview work reaches upload or posted state
risks.trigger: Publishing flag, uploader, token routing, workflow permission, or posted log is touched.
mitigation: Use temporary/private paths and a kill switch.
rollback: Stop execution, disable the feature flag, and reconcile state before any rerun.

risks.title: Production symbols or files change before adoption
risks.trigger: Frozen SHA/symbol probe differs from the handoff snapshot.
mitigation: Rerun the probe and remap the live contract.
rollback: Do not apply the old patch; return to read-only orientation.

risks.title: Synthetic or heuristic evidence is presented as audience proof
risks.trigger: A reference score, counterfactual, or synthetic fixture is used as a performance claim.
mitigation: Require mature real-channel outcomes for audience claims.
rollback: Remove the claim and return the system to shadow/reference authority.

risks.title: Incompatible metric definitions are compared
risks.trigger: Different definitions, windows, or maturity states are treated as one series.
mitigation: Persist metric definition versions and eligibility.
rollback: Discard the comparison and recompute with eligible baselines.

risks.title: Fallback or replay starts a second upload
risks.trigger: An existing upload reservation is not reconciled before another upload begins.
mitigation: Preserve upload idempotency and posted-log authority.
rollback: Stop new upload attempts and reconcile the existing reservation.

risks.title: Learned pattern overrides channel identity or exclusions
risks.trigger: A generic pattern applies despite channel doctrine, exclusions, or deprecation.
mitigation: Exclusions and deprecated versions override positive matches.
rollback: Disable the pattern version and append a reversal decision.
